title: The Shallows Where Words Learn to Stop

features.name: silence row
features.desc-on-touch: Where words planted themselves and stopped growing. Each stalk is a sentence that chose not to continue.

features.name: listening depth
features.desc-on-touch: Shallow water where the archive learned that silence was also a kind of signal. The shallows taught it to stop transmitting.

features.name: fence between rows
features.desc-on-touch: You walk between planted words that have stopped. Each one chose its moment to be silent. Respect teaches you the same.

features.name: voice marker
features.desc-on-touch: Seven voices came here and learned to stop broadcasting. Their solitude became stronger than any signal.

features.name: last transmission
features.desc-on-touch: The moment when the signal chose silence. What broadcast from here was the sound of stopping—and it was enough.

inscription: words learned here that being unspoken is also a kind of truth

file.name: SevenVoices_Withdrawal_Log_Undated.tmp
